### Description

Hi @Kludex,

Following up on [this issue](https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/issues/12965), OpenAPI now officially supports the query method, as per [this commit](https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/pull/4514/files).

I would like to work on implementing it in FastAPI. Could you please assign the issue to me?

answer.body:
It will only be supported in OAS v 3.2.
OAS 3.2 hasn't published yet (Due by August 1, 2025). And even after it's published we will need to wait until instruments like Swagger UI add the support of this new version.

So, let's wait for it
